failure_summary.description: Re-ran base searches instead of retrieving compatible cached results and filtering them with the new constraint.
Failed to save the returned result correctly: omitted saving, printed results, or passed a tool function instead of its result.
Mapped a state abbreviation to the city field and changed the user's attraction category text.
Repeated an unchanged domain search and ran a nearest-results call without an explicit proximity request.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already addresses cache filtering, argument mapping, and avoiding unrelated searches, so repeating those rules would not patch a gap. It says not to print results instead of saving them, but does not explicitly prohibit printing after saving or explicitly name the error of saving a tool function rather than its returned object.

edits.target: Do not call these tools inline, print their results instead of saving them, or save an assumed or differently named variable.
edits.content: Do not print tool results, even after saving them. Pass the result object returned by the call to `save_to_cache`; never pass the tool function itself (for example, do not use `value=search_hotels`).
